newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul bourse to list investment firm.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul bourse to list investment firm.

text.p: Part of Borusan Yatirim ve Pazarlama's share capital will start trading on the Istanbul Stock Exchange's national market on Monday, the exchange said.
The opening price will be 5,500 lira per a 1,000 lira nominal valued share.
The company, the investment arm of Borusan industrial group, floated 150 billion lira, or 30 percent of its share capital, in a two-day public offer last week.

Finansbank, offer co-leader said 60 percent of the offer was sold to 6,198 domestic investors, 21.27 percent to four institutional foreign investors, 7.77 percent to Borusan group's distributor agencies, 8.23 percent to investment funds and 2.73 percent to investment trusts.
It said Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette bought 23.5 billion lira worth shares, or 15.67 percent of the total offer.

In a separate statement, Borusan Yatirim said it earned 825 billion lira from the offer. The company holds equity stakes of between 11.7 and 50 percent in seven group companies active in the iron and steel, automotive sectors and foreign trade.
Part of Turkey's leading steel pipe producer Borusan Birlesik Boru Fabrikalari were listed on the Exhange two years ago.
